Unofficial web recreation · Minecraft 26.3 inspired

THE SIFT: BEYOND THE RIFT

Enter a strange dimension of siftslate, glowing Ichor, overgrown willow groves, and resonant stone. Search the map for five Charoite shards, then return to the Rift and press E.

This is a browser-made companion adventure using The Sift mod's art assets. It is not the original Fabric mod loaded inside Minecraft.

⌖

FIELD GUIDE

W A S D / Arrow keys move across the isometric map. Hold Shift to move faster. Find the floating purple Charoite shards, then stand next to the swirling Rift and press E. Rocks and old trees block your path. Your progress is saved on this device.

Tip: the mini map marks shards and the Rift. Ichor flats are slower to cross.

✦
Rift stabilized

THE SIFT OPENS

The five shards resonate, and the mist parts to reveal a hidden grove beyond the stone. Your expedition is complete — the world is still waiting to be explored.
